chapters.title: The Fine Print of Dying
chapters.goal: Establish Rhea's death, her arrival in the Ledger's frontier tutorial, and her first survival exploit using system wording.
chapters.stakes_shift: From mundane death to surviving a predatory magical onboarding process.

bridge.to_next: Rhea must secure basic resources now that she has bypassed the initial death-trap.

sections.title: The Bureaucracy of the Afterlife
sections.intent: Establish Rhea's death and her immediate, disorienting arrival in the Ledger's frontier tutorial zone, highlighting the hostile UI.
sections.end_condition: Rhea successfully parses her first System notification and avoids immediate environmental death.

scenes.summary: Rhea dies in a municipal records fire, experiencing the transition as a bureaucratic error rather than a spiritual awakening, and wakes up on a hard stone floor surrounded by floating blue text.
scenes.outcome: Rhea transitions from Earth to the Ledger's frontier tutorial zone, gaining the 'Deceased' status and her first System prompt.
scenes.transition_in_text: Smoke fills the municipal records room, choking Rhea before the world dissolves into a grid of blue light.
scenes.transition_out_text: The blue text flashes, demanding acknowledgment as the temperature in the room drops rapidly.

scenes.summary: Freezing on the stone floor, Rhea reads the environmental warning prompt and realizes she must accept the 'Terms of Arrival' to unlock the door, but spots a timer counting down to her death by hypothermia.
scenes.outcome: Rhea accepts the basic terms just in time to open the door, avoiding freezing to death but locking herself into the tutorial zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: Frost creeps across the stone floor as Rhea squints at the blinking cursor, her breath pluming in the freezing air.
scenes.transition_out_text: The iron door grinds open, spilling harsh yellow light into the freezing chamber.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea successfully parses her first System notification and avoids immediate environmental death.

sections.title: The Starter Pack Trap
sections.intent: Reveal that the tutorial's 'helpful' starter gear is actually a predatory debt trap designed to enslave new arrivals.
sections.end_condition: Rhea identifies the hidden interest rate on the starter gear and explicitly refuses the standard acceptance prompt.

scenes.summary: Rhea steps into the corridor and finds a pedestal offering a 'Merciful Starter Pack' containing basic clothes and a weapon, but the UI pushes her to click 'Accept All' without reading the details.
scenes.outcome: Rhea opens the detailed view of the starter pack, discovering the hidden terms.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea steps over the stone threshold into the harsh yellow light, her eyes locking onto a glowing pedestal in the center of the corridor.
scenes.transition_out_text: She taps the tiny 'Details' button hidden in the corner of the prompt, expanding a massive wall of fine print.

scenes.summary: Reading the fine print, Rhea realizes the 'Merciful Starter Pack' comes with a 400% daily interest rate on the 'value' of the items, payable in HP or labor, and refuses the prompt.
scenes.outcome: Rhea rejects the starter pack, leaving her freezing and unarmed but free of the predatory debt trap.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea scrolls through the massive wall of fine print, her municipal auditor instincts flaring at the buried clauses.
scenes.transition_out_text: She hits the 'Decline' button, causing the pedestal to retract into the floor with a disappointed chime.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea identifies the hidden interest rate on the starter gear and explicitly refuses the standard acceptance prompt.

sections.title: Exploiting the Fine Print
sections.intent: Rhea finds a loophole in the System's wording to secure basic gear without triggering the debt mechanics.
sections.end_condition: Rhea equips her first exploited item and receives a non-standard System confirmation of survival.

scenes.summary: Shivering in her hospital gown, Rhea searches the empty corridor for alternatives and notices that the pedestal's retraction mechanism left behind a loose iron gear and a torn piece of the 'Acceptance' scroll.
scenes.outcome: Rhea acquires the loose iron gear and torn scroll, realizing they are physical objects not bound by the prompt's digital contract.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea kneels by the empty slot where the pedestal retracted, shivering in her thin gown as she inspects the mechanism.
scenes.transition_out_text: She pries the iron gear loose from the floor mechanism, its heavy weight solidifying in her hand.

scenes.summary: Rhea wraps the torn scroll around the iron gear to create a makeshift bludgeon, triggering a System glitch that registers it as an 'Unsanctioned Tool' and grants her a non-standard survival confirmation.
scenes.outcome: Rhea equips the 'Unsanctioned Iron Bludgeon,' bypassing the debt trap and receiving her first untaxed item and a unique System notification.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea wraps the torn parchment tightly around the greasy iron gear, testing the weight of her makeshift weapon.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea equips her first exploited item and receives a non-standard System confirmation of survival.

chapters.title: Tariffs and Teeth
chapters.goal: Survive the initial resource loop by identifying the hidden taxes on basic survival gear and finding a loophole in the local economy.
chapters.stakes_shift: From immediate physical survival to economic viability in a rigged system.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea survived the drop but is starving and broke.
bridge.to_next: Having secured a baseline, Rhea attracts the attention of others trapped in the same loop.

sections.title: The Cost of Breathing
sections.intent: Rhea attempts to gather basic resources but encounters the local tariff mechanics that drain stamina and HP.
sections.end_condition: Rhea hits critical stamina levels and realizes standard gathering will bankrupt her HP before nightfall.

scenes.outcome: Rhea attempts to harvest a glowing root using the System's prompt, resulting in a severe stamina drain and a 'Gathering Tax' notification.
scenes.summary: Exiting the tutorial corridor, Rhea finds herself in the ash-covered Frontier Outskirts. Starving, she tries to pull a glowing root from the ground using the standard System interaction, only to be hit with a massive stamina penalty.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea pushes through the heavy iron exit door, her bare feet stepping onto the ash-covered soil of the frontier.
scenes.transition_out_text: She wraps her fingers around the glowing root, pulling upward just as a red penalty prompt flashes across her vision.

scenes.outcome: Rhea identifies that the 'Standard Gathering' action is a rigged mechanic designed to convert player stamina into System revenue, leaving her near death.
scenes.summary: Gasping for breath, Rhea reviews her status screen and the fine print of the Gathering Tax. She realizes that using the System's intended harvesting methods will drain her HP to zero before she can gather enough food to survive.
scenes.transition_in_text: The red prompt pulses in Rhea's vision, accompanied by a sharp, burning ache in her chest as her stamina bar plummets.
scenes.transition_out_text: She drops the useless root, clutching her ribs as she scans the jagged treeline for an alternative to the rigged mechanics.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea hits critical stamina levels and realizes standard gathering will bankrupt her HP before nightfall.

sections.title: Physics vs. The System
sections.intent: Rhea observes local mob behavior and loot drop rules, spotting a discrepancy between physics and System taxation.
sections.end_condition: Rhea successfully forces a mob to drop untaxed raw materials by exploiting a collision between environmental damage and loot generation.

scenes.outcome: Rhea observes a Scavenger Rat being crushed by a falling branch and notes that the resulting loot drop lacks the 'System Tax' tag.
scenes.summary: Limping toward a rocky ravine, Rhea watches a low-level Scavenger Rat forage. When a dead branch falls and crushes the rat, Rhea inspects the corpse and realizes environmental deaths bypass the System's combat and gathering taxes.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea limps toward the edge of a rocky ravine, her breath shallow as she watches a scavenger rat scurry beneath a dead tree.
scenes.transition_out_text: She hefts her makeshift iron bludgeon, eyeing a loose boulder perched precariously above the rat's patrol path.

scenes.outcome: Rhea uses her iron bludgeon to trigger a rockslide, crushing a rat and securing untaxed meat and hide.
scenes.summary: Instead of engaging the rat in taxed System combat, Rhea strikes the loose boulder with her iron gear. The resulting rockslide crushes the rat, generating 'Environmental Damage' and dropping untaxed raw materials.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea swings the heavy iron gear, striking the base of the loose boulder with a loud, echoing crack.
scenes.transition_out_text: She scrambles down the slope, her bare feet sliding on the loose gravel as she reaches the crushed rat and its glowing loot.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea successfully forces a mob to drop untaxed raw materials by exploiting a collision between environmental damage and loot generation.

sections.title: Establishing a Baseline
sections.intent: Rhea converts the untaxed materials into usable sustenance and currency, securing her immediate survival.
sections.end_condition: Rhea secures a positive daily resource yield and banks her first untaxed copper credits.

scenes.outcome: Rhea discovers a manual deposit chute on an automated kiosk, bypassing the taxed 'Sell' interface.
scenes.summary: Hauling the untaxed rat carcass to a glowing Outpost Kiosk, Rhea realizes the standard 'Sell' button includes a 40% transaction fee. She inspects the machine and finds a physical maintenance chute, deciding to manually deposit the items.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea hauls the bloody rat carcass out of the ravine, dragging it toward a glowing automated kiosk standing alone in the ash.
scenes.transition_out_text: She ignores the glowing 'Sell' button on the screen, instead shoving the raw meat directly into the rusted manual deposit chute at the base.

scenes.outcome: The kiosk processes the manual deposit as an 'Unsanctioned Barter', dispensing untaxed copper credits and a nutrient paste tube.
scenes.summary: The kiosk's internal gears grind as it processes the physical deposit. Lacking a digital contract to tax, the machine defaults to a raw material exchange rate, spitting out untaxed copper coins and a tube of nutrient paste, stabilizing Rhea's HP.
scenes.transition_in_text: The manual deposit chute grinds loudly, internal gears turning as the kiosk struggles to process the unsanctioned physical input.
scenes.transition_out_text: She pockets the copper coins, the cool metal a stark contrast to the warm nutrient paste tube she cracks open with her teeth.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea secures a positive daily resource yield and banks her first untaxed copper credits.

chapters.title: Mutual Damage
chapters.goal: Form a reluctant alliance with a local familiar/clerk and another trapped arrival based on shared incentives rather than trust.
chapters.stakes_shift: From solo survival to managing the liabilities and benefits of a party.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea's economic exploit gives her leverage to recruit.
bridge.to_next: The new party's combined skills allow them to analyze the quest board's underlying math.

sections.title: Unwanted Attention
sections.intent: Rhea's economic exploit draws the attention of a desperate fellow arrival and a cynical, low-level system clerk.
sections.end_condition: Rhea is cornered by the clerk and the arrival, forcing a tense negotiation over her exploit methodology.

scenes.outcome: Vance and Unit 734 confront Rhea about her bypassed transaction fee, demanding to know how she did it.
scenes.summary: As Rhea finishes eating her nutrient paste, a battered arrival named Vance and a floating, cynical system clerk drone designated Unit 734 approach her. Vance noticed her untaxed transaction, and the drone is annoyed by the 'unsanctioned barter' alert.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea tosses the empty nutrient paste tube onto the ash, wiping her mouth as a low mechanical hum approaches the kiosk.
scenes.transition_out_text: She backs against the kiosk chassis, gripping her iron bludgeon as the scarred man and the floating drone block her path.

scenes.outcome: Rhea negotiates a temporary truce, agreeing to demonstrate her exploit in exchange for Vance's combat protection and Unit 734's system access.
scenes.summary: Vance threatens to report her unless she shares the exploit, while Unit 734 offers to ignore the alert if they cut it in on the profits to meet its own quota. Rhea realizes she cannot fight them both and proposes a formal party structure to exploit the system together.
scenes.transition_in_text: The drone's optical lens whirs, projecting a red penalty warning onto the dirt between Rhea and the battered arrival.
scenes.transition_out_text: She lowers the iron bludgeon, extending a hand toward the man while keeping a wary eye on the hovering machine.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea is cornered by the clerk and the arrival, forcing a tense negotiation over her exploit methodology.

sections.title: A Test of Synergy
sections.intent: The trio tests a joint venture, combining Rhea's exploit with the arrival's combat skill and the clerk's limited system access.
sections.end_condition: The newly formed party successfully completes a rigged local quest with zero net loss to their resources.

scenes.outcome: The party successfully farms the rats using the environmental damage loophole, generating untaxed loot while Vance absorbs the aggro.
scenes.summary: Unit 734 pulls up a low-level 'Pest Control' quest that usually drains more durability than it pays out. Vance engages the scavenger rats in combat, deliberately avoiding killing blows, while Rhea uses the environment to finish them off, bypassing the combat tax.
scenes.transition_in_text: The drone projects a glowing blue quest board onto the side of a ruined concrete pillar, highlighting a pest control bounty.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vance kicks a rat toward the crumbling wall, giving Rhea the perfect angle to drop a heavy stone slab on its skull.

scenes.outcome: The party cashes out their combined loot, proving the synergy works and securing a net positive resource gain for all three.
scenes.summary: They haul the untaxed loot back to the kiosk. Unit 734 uses its clerk access to mask the manual deposit as a 'maintenance flush,' allowing them to cash out the quest rewards and the raw materials without triggering the 40% transaction fee.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea drags the sack of rat carcasses across the ash, following the drone's blinking navigation light back to the automated kiosk.
scenes.transition_out_text: The rusted chute spits out a heavy stream of copper coins, clinking loudly against the metal collection tray.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The newly formed party successfully completes a rigged local quest with zero net loss to their resources.

sections.title: The Liability Contract
sections.intent: Formalize the party alliance using Rhea's strict, loophole-free legal wording to prevent future betrayal.
sections.end_condition: The System registers the party under a custom, highly restrictive liability contract.

scenes.outcome: Rhea drafts a custom party contract that explicitly forbids friendly fire, loot skimming, and unilateral reporting, using her fraud investigator background to close every loophole.
scenes.summary: With the copper divided, Vance suggests forming a standard System Party. Rhea, distrustful of default Ledger contracts, insists on drafting a custom liability agreement. She forces Unit 734 to pull up the raw contract syntax.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vance scoops his share of the copper coins from the tray, pulling up his standard system interface to send a party invite.
scenes.transition_out_text: Rhea rejects the glowing blue invite prompt, forcing the drone to project the raw, scrolling green text of the contract syntax.

scenes.outcome: The System accepts the custom contract, officially forming the party and locking in their mutual obligations.
scenes.summary: Vance and Unit 734 balk at the restrictive terms but realize they need Rhea's exploit to survive the frontier. They sign the custom contract, officially binding the trio together under Rhea's strict legal framework.
scenes.transition_in_text: The green text of the custom contract hovers in the air, casting a sickly light over Vance's scarred face and the drone's chassis.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The System registers the party under a custom, highly restrictive liability contract.

chapters.title: The Skim
chapters.goal: Investigate the local quest payouts and discover that the Ledger's standard rewards are being actively siphoned by a local administrator.
chapters.stakes_shift: From surviving the environment to recognizing the environment is a managed fraud scheme.

bridge.from_prev: The party notices discrepancies in their XP and loot yields.
bridge.to_next: Armed with proof of the skim, Rhea decides to weaponize the system's own audit rules.

sections.title: Mathematical Discrepancies
sections.intent: As the party grinds quests, Rhea notices the math on XP and loot yields doesn't match the System's stated formulas.
sections.end_condition: Rhea compiles a ledger of missing XP and loot, proving a mathematical discrepancy in the local node.

scenes.summary: The newly formed party takes on a standard gathering quest in the Ash Thickets to test their contract. After completing it, Rhea notices the XP and loot drops are exactly 14.3% lower than the System's stated base rates in the contract syntax.
scenes.outcome: Rhea identifies a consistent 14.3% deficit in their quest rewards compared to the raw System formulas.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea closes the glowing green contract window, turning her attention to the physical quest board bolted to the kiosk chassis.
scenes.transition_out_text: She kneels in the gray dirt, comparing the severed ash-boar tusk to the projected loot table hovering above her palm.

scenes.summary: Rhea forces Unit 734 to pull up the historical logs for the last fifty local quests. She cross-references the data, compiling a makeshift ledger on a piece of scrap parchment that proves the local node is mathematically skimming off the top.
scenes.outcome: Rhea compiles a ledger of missing XP and loot, proving a mathematical discrepancy in the local node.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vance wipes boar blood from his iron bludgeon while Rhea demands the drone project the historical quest logs against a charred tree trunk.
scenes.transition_out_text: She rolls up the scrap parchment, tapping the charcoal stick against her chin as she stares at the undeniable deficit.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea compiles a ledger of missing XP and loot, proving a mathematical discrepancy in the local node.

sections.title: Tracking the Leak
sections.intent: The party investigates the missing value, tracking it through the local frontier node's routing system.
sections.end_condition: The party discovers the digital skim point where the local administrator is routing the stolen rewards.

scenes.summary: Back at the Outpost, Rhea interrogates Unit 734 about where the missing 14.3% goes. The drone insists it goes to 'Node Maintenance,' but Rhea uses her fraud investigator skills to trace the routing logic, finding a hidden sub-routine.
scenes.outcome: Rhea bypasses the drone's basic security filters to reveal a hidden routing sub-routine siphoning the rewards.
scenes.transition_in_text: The drone docks with the rusted kiosk port, its optical lens flickering as Rhea inputs a series of diagnostic queries.
scenes.transition_out_text: The green text stutters, revealing a secondary data stream flowing toward the administrative spire in the distance.

scenes.summary: The party follows the physical manifestation of the data stream—a series of buried, glowing conduit lines—into the restricted Maintenance Trenches beneath the outpost. Vance handles a minor security construct that tries to block their path.
scenes.outcome: The party infiltrates the restricted Maintenance Trenches, defeating a low-level security construct to follow the data conduit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vance pries open the heavy iron grate at the base of the kiosk, revealing a narrow, glowing tunnel beneath the ash.
scenes.transition_out_text: The shattered remains of the brass security construct spark on the stone floor as Rhea steps over it to follow the blue conduit.

scenes.summary: Deep in the trenches, they find a physical server terminal—the digital skim point. Rhea analyzes the terminal and discovers the stolen rewards are being routed directly to the local administrator's personal offshore Ledger account.
scenes.outcome: The party discovers the digital skim point where the local administrator is routing the stolen rewards.
scenes.transition_in_text: The narrow tunnel opens into a damp, humming chamber dominated by a massive brass server terminal leaking blue light.
scenes.transition_out_text: Rhea traces the thickest glowing cable from the terminal, her eyes narrowing at the administrator's personal account tag etched into the brass.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The party discovers the digital skim point where the local administrator is routing the stolen rewards.

sections.title: Securing the Evidence
sections.intent: Rhea secures hard evidence of the administrative fraud before the system can wipe the logs.
sections.end_condition: Rhea locks the proof of the skim into her personal, unalterable System inventory.

scenes.summary: The terminal's automated defense system detects their intrusion and begins a localized memory wipe to destroy the logs. Rhea frantically works to extract the raw data packet while Vance physically holds the terminal's cooling vents open to prevent a hard reset.
scenes.outcome: Rhea successfully extracts the raw data packet containing the skim logs before the terminal can wipe its memory.
scenes.transition_in_text: A shrill alarm pierces the damp chamber as the brass terminal flashes red, initiating a localized memory wipe protocol.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vance releases the scorching cooling vents with a curse, dropping to the stone floor as Rhea clutches the glowing data crystal.

scenes.summary: With the data crystal in hand, Rhea realizes the local system will try to delete it from her standard inventory. She exploits a loophole in their new custom party contract to bind the crystal as a 'Soul-Bound Liability,' locking it into her unalterable personal System inventory.
scenes.outcome: Rhea locks the proof of the skim into her personal, unalterable System inventory.
scenes.transition_in_text: The red alarm lights fade to a dull amber as Rhea stares at the pulsing data crystal in her palm, watching its durability meter rapidly decay.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea locks the proof of the skim into her personal, unalterable System inventory.

chapters.title: Auditing Reality
chapters.goal: Execute a mid-level exploit that forces the system to refund stolen XP/loot, drawing the ire of the local frontier overseer.
chapters.stakes_shift: From passive victim of the skim to active threat to the local power structure.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea files a metaphysical grievance through the Ledger.
bridge.to_next: The overseer retaliates using administrative debt mechanics.

sections.title: Filing the Grievance
sections.intent: Rhea drafts and submits a metaphysical grievance using the Ledger's own obscure audit rules.
sections.end_condition: Rhea successfully submits the grievance, triggering an automated System freeze on the local node's assets.

scenes.summary: Still in the Maintenance Trenches, Rhea uses the locked data crystal to draft a formal metaphysical grievance. She forces Unit 734 to provide the exact bureaucratic syntax required to bypass local filters and send the complaint directly to the Ledger's core audit sub-routine.
scenes.outcome: Rhea successfully formats the grievance using the correct administrative syntax.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea holds the pulsing data crystal up to the dim amber light of the Maintenance Trenches, demanding Unit 734 project the Ledger's core grievance forms.
scenes.transition_out_text: She finalizes the glowing text block, her finger hovering over the execution rune etched into the terminal.

scenes.summary: Rhea submits the grievance. The system immediately registers the discrepancy and initiates an automated freeze on the local node's assets. The terminal locks down, and warning klaxons blare as the environment shifts into an active audit state.
scenes.outcome: Rhea successfully submits the grievance, triggering an automated System freeze on the local node's assets.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea slams her palm against the execution rune, sending the glowing text block spiraling into the brass terminal's core.
scenes.transition_out_text: The klaxons shift to a deafening, rhythmic pulse as the heavy iron blast doors begin to grind open toward the surface.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea successfully submits the grievance, triggering an automated System freeze on the local node's assets.

sections.title: The Violent Refund
sections.intent: The System processes the audit, violently refunding the stolen XP and loot to the party in the middle of a hostile zone.
sections.end_condition: The party survives the chaotic influx of refunded power and levels up significantly.

scenes.summary: Fleeing the locked-down trenches, the party emerges onto the Outpost Surface just as the System begins processing the refund. The sky turns a violent, glitching purple, and raw XP and loot begin raining down on them in physical, concussive bursts.
scenes.outcome: The party is caught in a dangerous, physical storm of refunded System value.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vance kicks the grinding blast doors apart, dragging Rhea out onto the ash-covered surface of the Outpost.
scenes.transition_out_text: A jagged shard of crystallized experience points shatters against Vance's shield, knocking him back into the dirt.

scenes.summary: The refund becomes a hazard. The sheer volume of back-paid XP and physical items threatens to crush them or overload their physical capacities. Rhea has to rapidly allocate stats and manage inventory space on the fly to prevent a fatal system overload.
scenes.outcome: Rhea and Vance rapidly allocate stats and manage inventory to survive the violent influx of rewards.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea drops to her knees in the dirt, frantically swiping through her flashing inventory screens as heavy iron ingots materialize out of thin air.
scenes.transition_out_text: She confirms the final stat allocation, gasping as the crushing pressure of unspent experience points finally dissipates from her chest.

scenes.summary: The storm of value subsides. The party stands amidst a crater of refunded loot, having leveled up significantly. They take a moment to assess their new stats and the sheer absurdity of surviving a bureaucratic payout.
scenes.outcome: The party survives the chaotic influx of refunded power and levels up significantly.
scenes.transition_in_text: The violent purple sky snaps back to a dull gray, leaving the party standing in a smoking crater filled with scattered coins and glowing pelts.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vance hefts his newly upgraded iron bludgeon, staring warily at the administrative spire looming in the distance.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The party survives the chaotic influx of refunded power and levels up significantly.

sections.title: The Overseer's Gaze
sections.intent: The local overseer realizes what happened and manually overrides the automated system to target Rhea.
sections.end_condition: The party receives a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning directly from the overseer.

scenes.summary: The automated freeze is suddenly overridden. The local overseer, realizing the node's assets have been frozen, manually forces a connection to Rhea's party. Unit 734's chassis is hijacked to project a massive, furious avatar of the overseer.
scenes.outcome: The local overseer manually overrides the system and identifies Rhea as the source of the audit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Unit 734 suddenly convulses, its optical lens projecting a blinding red beam that paints the ash-covered ground.
scenes.transition_out_text: The projected avatar glares down at Rhea, its voice booming with the unmistakable weight of administrative authority.

scenes.summary: The overseer issues a direct threat, bypassing standard dialogue to slap the party with a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning. This debuff marks them as hostile to the local environment, setting the stage for a brutal counter-attack.
scenes.outcome: The party receives a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning directly from the overseer.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea stands her ground beneath the towering red projection, crossing her arms as the overseer's avatar begins to dictate the terms of their punishment.
scenes.transition_out_text: The red projection collapses back into the drone, leaving a burning crimson warning icon permanently etched into the corner of Rhea's vision.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The party receives a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning directly from the overseer.

chapters.title: Administrative Cruelty
chapters.goal: Survive the overseer's targeted harassment, which uses debt logic and rigged encounters to try and bankrupt Rhea's HP and resources.
chapters.stakes_shift: From flying under the radar to fighting a defensive war against the system's bureaucracy.

bridge.from_prev: The overseer flags Rhea's party for 'audit compliance' encounters.
bridge.to_next: Pushed to the brink, Rhea prepares a counter-audit to crash the local node.

sections.title: Weaponized Bureaucracy
sections.intent: The overseer weaponizes the environment, spawning debt-collecting mobs and applying severe administrative debuffs.
sections.end_condition: The party barely escapes the first wave of rigged encounters, their resources heavily drained.

sections.title: Targeting the Ledger
sections.intent: Rhea realizes they cannot out-fight the system's infinite resources and must attack the overseer's mana/debt ledger directly.
sections.end_condition: Rhea identifies the specific administrative hub powering the overseer's targeted harassment.

sections.title: Preparing the Counter-Audit
sections.intent: The party prepares a counter-audit, gathering the specific items and exploits needed to crash the local node.
sections.end_condition: The party stands at the threshold of the administrative sanctum, fully equipped for the breach.

chapters.title: The Mercy Cache
chapters.goal: Breach the local administrative hub, expose the systemic leak, and defeat the overseer by turning his own predatory contracts against him.
chapters.stakes_shift: From desperate defense to dismantling the local frontier authority.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea corners the overseer in his own administrative sanctum.
bridge.to_next: With the local node broken, the wider Ledger system takes notice.

sections.title: Breaching the Sanctum
sections.intent: The party fights through the overseer's elite bureaucratic guards and trap-laden architecture.
sections.end_condition: The party breaches the inner office, confronting the overseer directly.

sections.title: The Default
sections.intent: The overseer tries to enforce a lethal predatory contract, but Rhea turns the wording against him using her gathered proof.
sections.end_condition: Rhea triggers a catastrophic default on the overseer's contract, stripping his administrative shields.

sections.title: System Crash
sections.intent: The party defeats the vulnerable overseer, causing the local frontier node to crash.
sections.end_condition: The overseer is deleted, and the System broadcasts a critical failure across the frontier zone.

chapters.title: Institutional Access
chapters.goal: Loot the overseer's vault, secure the administrative residue as proof, and transition out of the frontier zone toward the civic layer.
chapters.stakes_shift: From conquering the tutorial to entering the vastly more dangerous institutional world.

bridge.from_prev: The frontier zone destabilizes following the overseer's defeat.
bridge.to_next: Rhea heads to the city, ready to audit the real powers of the Ledger.

sections.title: Looting the Cache
sections.intent: The party loots the collapsing sanctum, securing the 'Mercy Cache' and high-tier administrative residue.
sections.end_condition: Rhea secures the administrative residue in her inventory, gaining a permanent, illicit system access token.

sections.title: Outrunning the Purge
sections.intent: The frontier zone begins to purge and reset, forcing the party to flee toward the civic layer boundary.
sections.end_condition: The party successfully crosses the boundary out of the frontier zone just as it collapses behind them.

sections.title: The Civic Layer
sections.intent: Rhea and her party look toward the vast, institutional city, ready to scale their exploits.
sections.end_condition: Rhea receives a new, high-stakes System prompt welcoming her to the civic layer, setting up Book 2.
